llm.summary: This skill is a documentation-only PR review memory tool whose persistence and review-data capture are disclosed and aligned with its purpose.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to capture, organize, and retrieve durable PR-review knowledge in a project memory palace; the artifact contents consistently describe review findings, decisions, patterns, standards, lessons, and search workflows.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill includes automatic capture after a related PR-review workflow and proactive surfacing of past review knowledge, but these behaviors are clearly described and limited to PR-review context.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains Markdown skill files only, with no executable scripts, installers, or hidden setup actions. It declares related configuration dependencies for the broader Night Market memory-palace workflow.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Examples reference slash commands and a local palace_manager.py search/export workflow, which are proportionate to maintaining a review knowledge base and do not show unrelated file, credential, or network access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill intentionally stores PR discussion context, participants, tags, links, and review findings in persistent searchable memory; this is disclosed and central to the feature.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing, make sure your team is comfortable with PR review discussions, participant names, file references, and architectural decisions being saved in a persistent searchable memory palace. Avoid capturing sensitive security details or private business context unless that storage location is approved.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector clean result] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues, and artifact review did not identify hidden or purpose-mismatched behavior.
[Static scan clean result] expected: Static scan reported no findings; the artifact set is Markdown-only and contains no executable payloads.
[VirusTotal clean telemetry] expected: VirusTotal reported zero malicious or suspicious detections, used only as supporting telemetry.
